editorialNote: Preconditions and productions for this beat live in StoryBeat (Sources/StoryEngine/Domain) — the engine is the single source. Pages 2 and 4. The child puts things together into an idea. Register differs by family and must be declared: Family I voices it as a QUESTION or a maybe, which keeps page 6 available; Family V voices it with CERTAINTY, because the misreading has to be held confidently before it can be gently overturned. A tentative line in a Misreading story has nothing to overturn. `register` partitions this beat the same way castRoles partitions meet_companion, but the wanted value is DERIVED from the family by the engine, so a validator reading only the corpus cannot know the mapping. It can still count the partition: every declared register must clear the bound-pool floor on its own. At 3 and 3 it did not, and a Misreading story had three ways to voice the belief its whole book overturns.
